(4) At any meeting of the Rule Committee four
members shall be a quorum, of whom the Chief Justice
or a Judge shall always be one.

(5) All questions shall be decided by a majority of
votes of the members present and voting. In the event
of the equality of votas, the Chairman shall have a
second or casting vote.
